review_notes: I read the whole file and the related definitions. `omegaPermHom` is built from Mathlib's `Functor.mapEnd` composed with the local `permToEnd` monoid hom. `omegaSkeinRep` uses `MonoidAlgebra.lift`. `SymGroupAlgebra` is an `abbrev` for `MonoidAlgebra ℂ (Equiv.Perm (Fin n))`, so it is not a competing structure. `skeinRep` in SkeinTower follows the same lift pattern. I found no independent re-implementation of an existing Mathlib, Batteries or core concept. The named wrappers `omegaPermHom` and `omegaSkeinRep` are thin specialisations that use the existing generic API, so I abstained. I did not check how the wrappers are used elsewhere in the library.
